note: Doc section 4.3 lists these 12 v1 skills. Creature files currently use job-flavoured skill ids (smithing, guarding, sneaking, cooking, healing, lore, farming, hunting, tracking, trading, brewing, tinkering) - 12 distinct ids, but not this list. Mapping the creature ids onto these 12 (e.g. smithing/cooking/brewing -> crafting, hunting/tracking -> survival, guarding -> melee) is still open; this file does not rewrite the creature files.
source_doc: ecs-architecture.md v1.0/v1.1, section 4.3. Note: section 2.3 says 'v1 只做 6 个技能', which contradicts the 12 here - needs a user decision on which count is right.
